name: browser
description: 任何网页任务的首选入口（打开/登录/点击/填表/下载/读取 JS 渲染内容/截图）。不要用 terminal 的 curl/wget 代替浏览器操作。浏览器操作工具（CDP + MOSS 浏览器扩展）：可操作加载了 MOSS 扩展的任意 Chromium 浏览器（Chrome/Edge/Brave 等），也可启动 MOSS 内置 Chrome。MOSS 启动时不会打开或打扰浏览器；扩展仅在用户在「设置 → 浏览器」点击安装（或调用 action='setup'）时安装，并保留现有登录态。首次 action='open' 会新建独立的 MOSS 浏览器窗口：窗口在后台打开、不抢当前窗口焦点，标签仍自动归入「MOSS」标签组；后续 open 复用该窗口。绝不接管用户已有标签页。推荐循环：先 action='status' 查看桥接/实例与安装状态；页面操作前先 action='snapshot' 获取带 ref=eN 的可交互元素树，再用 click/type/press_key/select/hover/scroll/drag 按 ref 操作，页面变化后重新 snapshot；drag 用于滑块/地图/画布等按住拖拽；screenshot 返回截图；tabs 列出 AI 标签页；evaluate 可执行页面 JS（受配置限制）。跨域 iframe/游戏：先 action='frames' 列出子会话，再用 frame='auto' 或 targetId；frame 子会话可单独截图/按键。连续输入：action='hold'（按住指定毫秒）或 action='macro'（一次调用内执行 key_down/key_up/hold/click/wait/screenshot/wait_stable 序列），不要连发瞬时 press_key。验证：macro 默认返回首尾画面差分 effect=changed/no-change；wait_stable/wait_change 用于等待画面稳定/确认动作生效。click 支持 coord_space='screenshot'（直接使用截图上的像素，自动按缩放换算）。支持三种控制模式（设置→浏览器切换）：内置 Chrome / 浏览器扩展 / 外部 CDP 直连；CDP 模式可连接任意以 --remote-debugging-port 启动的 Chromium 浏览器或 Electron 应用（按次用 cdp_endpoint 指定端点）。
description_en: The preferred entry point for any web task (open/login/click/fill/download/render JS/read content/screenshot). Do not use terminal curl/wget instead of a browser. Browser automation tool (CDP + MOSS browser extension): drives any Chromium browser with the MOSS extension installed (Chrome/Edge/Brave etc.), or launches MOSS built-in Chrome. Startup never opens or disturbs browsers; the extension is installed only when the user clicks install in Settings → Browser (or calls action='setup'), preserving existing logins. The first action='open' creates a dedicated MOSS browser window in the background (without stealing focus from the current window); tabs are still grouped under the "MOSS" tab group, and later opens reuse that window. It never takes over existing user tabs. Recommended loop: action='status' to inspect bridge/instances and installer state; before page actions call action='snapshot' to get the accessible element tree with ref=eN, then click/type/press_key/select/hover/scroll/drag by ref, and re-snapshot after page changes. drag performs press-move-release gestures for sliders/maps/canvases. screenshot returns an image; tabs lists AI tabs; evaluate runs page JS (subject to config). Three control modes (Settings → Browser): built-in Chrome / browser extension / external CDP. CDP mode can attach to any Chromium browser or Electron app started with --remote-debugging-port (use cdp_endpoint per call).

action.description: 操作类型。观察：status/snapshot/screenshot/tabs/console/wait；建页与管理：setup/open/focus/close；页面操作：navigate/click/hover/type/press_key/select/scroll/drag/evaluate。

tab.description: AI 标签页 id（如 t1；来自 open/tabs 的返回）。缺省使用当前 AI 标签页
tab.description_en: AI tab id (e.g. t1; from open/tabs). Defaults to the current AI tab.

auto_focus.description: 操作前自动聚焦目标标签页（缺省 true）；只切换活动标签、不把浏览器窗口抬到前台，避免整窗闪烁；需要置前请单独调用 action=focus
auto_focus.description_en: Auto-focus the target tab before acting (default true); only switches the active tab and never raises the browser window (prevents window flashing); use action=focus when the window must come to front.

browser.description: 浏览器实例选择：缺省按设置的模式（builtin/extension/cdp）；也可显式 auto / builtin / external（或 extension）/ cdp / status 返回的实例 id
browser.description_en: Browser instance: defaults to the configured mode (builtin/extension/cdp); can be auto / builtin / external (or extension) / cdp / an instance id from status.

cdp_endpoint.description: CDP 模式端点（http://host:port、host:port、纯端口或 ws://）；传入后本次及后续调用使用该端点，可连接任意以 --remote-debugging-port 启动的 Chromium 浏览器或 Electron 应用
cdp_endpoint.description_en: CDP endpoint (http://host:port, host:port, bare port, or ws://); once passed, this and later calls use it. Connects to any Chromium browser or Electron app started with --remote-debugging-port.

url.description: 要打开的网址（open/navigate）；无协议前缀时自动补 https://
url.description_en: URL to open (open/navigate); https:// is prepended when the scheme is missing.

ref.description: snapshot 返回的元素引用（如 e3），用于 click/hover/type/select/scroll
ref.description_en: Element ref from snapshot (e.g. e3) for click/hover/type/select/scroll.

frame.description: 目标 iframe 子会话：auto / targetId / URL 子串（先用 action=frames 查看）。指定 frame 时 click 的 x/y 使用该 iframe 的 CSS 坐标；screenshot 只截该 iframe 画面。
frame.description_en: Target iframe sub-session: auto / targetId / URL substring (list with action=frames). When frame is set, click x/y are iframe-local CSS pixels and screenshot captures only that iframe.

coord_space.description: click 的 x/y 坐标系：viewport（缺省，CSS 视口像素）/ screenshot（最近一次截图的像素，工具自动按缩放换算）
coord_space.description_en: Coordinate space for click x/y: viewport (default, CSS pixels) / screenshot (pixels on the last screenshot; converted automatically).

region.description: 截图/帧差裁剪区域（CSS 像素）：{x,y,width,height}
region.description_en: Crop region for screenshot/frame diff in CSS pixels: {x,y,width,height}.

keys.description: hold 要同时按住的按键列表（如 ["ArrowRight"]）

duration_ms.description: hold 按住时长（毫秒，最大 5000）；drag 的总时长也使用该字段
duration_ms.description_en: Hold duration in ms (max 5000); drag also uses this field.

verify.description: macro 是否在首尾做画面差分（缺省 true）；返回 effect=changed/no-change
verify.description_en: Whether macro compares frames before/after (default true); returns effect=changed/no-change.

stable_samples.description: wait_stable 连续稳定采样次数（缺省 2）
stable_samples.description_en: Consecutive stable samples required by wait_stable (default 2).

selector.description: CSS 选择器（ref 的替代定位方式）

x.description: 点击坐标 X（视口像素，click 且无 ref/selector 时使用）
x.description_en: Click X in viewport pixels (used when click has no ref/selector).

y.description: 点击坐标 Y（视口像素）

from_ref.description: 拖动起点元素引用（drag，如 e3）
from_ref.description_en: Drag start element ref (drag, e.g. e3).

from_selector.description: 拖动起点 CSS 选择器（drag）

from_x.description: 拖动起点 X（视口像素，drag 且无 from_ref/from_selector 时使用）
from_x.description_en: Drag start X in viewport pixels (used when drag has no from_ref/from_selector).

from_y.description: 拖动起点 Y（视口像素）
from_y.description_en: Drag start Y in viewport pixels.

to_ref.description: 拖动终点元素引用（drag，如 e5）
to_ref.description_en: Drag end element ref (drag, e.g. e5).

to_selector.description: 拖动终点 CSS 选择器（drag）

to_x.description: 拖动终点 X（视口像素）
to_x.description_en: Drag end X in viewport pixels.

to_y.description: 拖动终点 Y（视口像素）
to_y.description_en: Drag end Y in viewport pixels.

steps.description: 拖动插值步数（drag；缺省 12，越多越接近真实手势）
steps.description_en: Drag interpolation steps (drag; default 12, higher is closer to a real gesture).

click_count.description_en: Click count for click (default 1; 2 = double click).

replace.description: type 时先全选替换原内容（缺省 false，追加输入）

submit.description: type 后按 Enter 提交

values.description: 下拉框要选中的值/文本（select，可多个）
values.description_en: Option values/texts to select (select, multiple allowed).

delta_y.description: 垂直滚动量（scroll；缺省 600，正数向下）
delta_y.description_en: Vertical scroll delta (scroll; default 600, positive = down).

expression.description: 在页面执行的 JavaScript 表达式（evaluate；支持 await Promise）
expression.description_en: JavaScript expression to evaluate in the page (evaluate; awaits promises).

wait_selector.description: 等待 CSS 选择器出现（wait）
wait_selector.description_en: Wait until this CSS selector appears (wait).

wait_text.description: 等待页面正文包含指定文本（wait）
wait_text.description_en: Wait until page text contains this string (wait).

full_page.description: screenshot 是否截整页（缺省 false，仅视口）
full_page.description_en: Capture the full page in screenshot (default false, viewport only).

clear.description: console 读取后清空缓冲（缺省 false）
clear.description_en: Clear console buffer after reading (default false).

max_nodes.description: snapshot 最大节点数（缺省取工具配置 maxSnapshotNodes）
max_nodes.description_en: Max snapshot nodes (defaults to tool config maxSnapshotNodes).

all.description: tabs 是否列出该浏览器全部标签页（缺省 false，仅 AI 标签页）
all.description_en: List all tabs of the browser (default false, AI tabs only).

timeout_ms.description: 本次操作超时毫秒数（缺省取工具配置 timeoutMs）
timeout_ms.description_en: Operation timeout in ms (defaults to tool config timeoutMs).
